topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Well, looks like the ground’s been good to us this year, and I reckon it could be good to you too, if you’ve a mind for the work. I’ve been tending this soil since I was no taller than the hoe, and I know it holds more life than what we’ve been takin' from it. If you’re serious 'bout puttin’ in the sweat, I don’t see no harm in sharin’ a bit of the yard. Just make sure you treat it right, and maybe, come harvest, we’ll both have a little extra to thank the saints for.
